readings: Rice season, Aqua and S-NPP: the pair holds in neither tested province, so no band carries the 'same on both' label: Sindh was not tested (only 1 eligible year, below 6), so each satellite's band is shown for its eligible years, labelled 'not tested: too few years with enough detections'; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa was not tested (only 1 eligible year, below 6), so each satellite's band is shown for its eligible years, labelled 'not tested: too few years with enough detections'.

Sindh, rice season (15 Sep–31 Dec), Aqua and S-NPP: not tested (1 eligible year, below 6); each satellite's band is shown for its eligible years, labelled 'not tested: too few years with enough detections'.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, rice season (15 Sep–31 Dec), Aqua and S-NPP: not tested (1 eligible year, below 6); each satellite's band is shown for its eligible years, labelled 'not tested: too few years with enough detections'.
Punjab, spring season (15 Mar–30 Jun), Aqua and S-NPP: both dates fail; each satellite's band is shown side by side, with no 'same on both' label (12 of 13 eligible years outside the tolerance).

Sindh, spring season (15 Mar–30 Jun), Aqua and S-NPP: not tested (0 eligible years, below 6); each satellite's band is shown for its eligible years, labelled 'not tested: too few years with enough detections'.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, spring season (15 Mar–30 Jun), Aqua and S-NPP: not tested (0 eligible years, below 6); each satellite's band is shown for its eligible years, labelled 'not tested: too few years with enough detections'.
Sindh, rice season (15 Sep–31 Dec): NOAA-20's dates are labelled 'matched S-NPP's dates within the tolerance in 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025'.
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, rice season (15 Sep–31 Dec): NOAA-20's dates are labelled 'matched S-NPP's dates within the tolerance in 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025'.
Punjab, spring season (15 Mar–30 Jun): NOAA-20's dates are labelled 'matched S-NPP's dates within the tolerance in 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025'.
Sindh, spring season (15 Mar–30 Jun): NOAA-20's dates are labelled 'matched S-NPP's dates within the tolerance in 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025'.
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, spring season (15 Mar–30 Jun): NOAA-20's dates are labelled 'not tested'.
Punjab, rice season, both pairs: each satellite's band is shown side by side, labelled 'development area (dates seen before the test)'. Punjab's rice dates are not tested.
Spring is read the same way, province by province (Punjab included), and independently of rice: only a pair that holds gets the label.
After S-NPP's end, NOAA-20's own dates are shown only for complete windows, each labelled with its pair's outcome and its stream; the first is rice 2026, complete on 31 Dec 2026.
Historical dates only, never a forecast.
band_title: the season's middle and end dates (detected burning activity)
approved: Hasnain, 8 Nov 2026: 'Run without it' - his answer to 'Run P04's tests before the checker's P04-CL report arrives?' (DECISIONS.md, commit 9833fdd; change log entry 2, commit 5a9a241)
filters: standard stream; quality rule (MODIS confidence >= 30; VIIRS confidence nominal or high (n/h)); type-0 screen; day passes only (daynight D)

rules.days: dates on the pair's matched days, in calendar order; a province-year needs at least 100 of the window's 108 matched days
rules.floor: each satellite >= 200 day-pass detections on the pair's matched days
rules.dates: middle = first matched day with 2 x cumulative >= total; end = first with 10 x cumulative >= 9 x total (whole numbers)
rules.gap: counted in matched-day positions; removed days never count as disagreement
rules.holds: |gap| <= 3 (middle) and <= 4 (end) in all but floor(0.2 x n) eligible years; the pair holds only if both dates hold; not testable below 6 eligible years
rules.punjab_rice: development area: dates shown, not tested
